layer_at_fault_line: P1's mark cell reads 'Fitted', a provenance word, not one of the eight marks; SKILL.md's Step 6 warns explicitly, 'Five word lists, each in its place, never mixed ... A word from one list never stands in another's place: asserted is not a mark' -- the report's own conflation, not one the skill's wording caused.
quotes: test_pull/pairs_that_pull rests on: 'P2 (slender lead) pulls against P4 (increasing returns). Make the returns stronger and the seed stops mattering; make them weaker and the choice is recoverable. David never says where the line is drawn.' | test_rival/rivals_built/same_explanation rests on: 'Best rival. "QWERTY was adopted because it was the better keyboard given the engineering of the day, and the DSK advantage is overstated." What separates them: a case where the early leader lost, or a lock-in that failed. Neither side offers one.' | test_patches rests on: 'The move from one case (P1-P8) to P10 is asserted, not measured.
